title: Rabbi Shemayah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Tosefta Bava Metzia, chapter 6, mentions him saying, “Anyone who has money and does not lend it at interest,” etc. The Babylonian Talmud, Bava Metzia 76a as cited here, reads Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar.
Yoma 53b says, “They said in the name of Shemayah”; Dikdukei Soferim reads “in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai.”
Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer, chapter 15, also has “Rabbi Shemayah says,” etc.

notes.text: The notice preserves the explicit not-lending-at-interest wording and its Shimon ben Elazar attribution. The other citation gives Shemayah versus Shimon ben Yochai.
The consulted Yoma 53b reads “in the name of Shemayah.” The other citations and the Dikdukei Soferim reading are reported here from Hyman.
